entities.name: Asen Dynasty & Restoration
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Asen brothers' revolt restored Bulgarian statehood. Tsar Kaloyan defeated the Latin Crusaders at Adrianople (1205). Ivan Asen II (1218–1241) expanded Bulgaria to its greatest territorial extent since Simeon, controlling most of the Balkans.
